analysis:
The PR changes only docs/provider/cli-reference.md. Visible changes are the "Last updated" date (line 3) and the benchmark "Runtime generation" row (line 564). The row now documents `--runtime-concurrency <sizes>` and `--runtime-stagger`, citing `RuntimeConcurrencyBenchmark.swift`. The patch metadata also lists a head-side change at lines 1208-1209, which is not visible in the supplied base text. The patch excerpt is truncated, so I could not review that range.

I found no security regression. No code, authorization, attestation, encryption or coordinator-contract behavior changes in the visible text. The runtime-generation row still says production slot output and memory are emitted as JSON with the prefix cache off. This does not touch T-041, the cache TTL, the HMAC lookup tags or the cache-scope boundary. The benchmark flags are developer or operator CLI options. I saw no evidence that they widen the provider network surface, plaintext handling or the A-001/A-003 key assets.

Remaining uncertainty: the implementation of the new flags in `RuntimeConcurrencyBenchmark.swift` is outside the supplied evidence. If it handles prompt files, writes outputs or enables the prefix cache, it deserves its own code review. The head-side lines 1208-1209 should be checked in the other batch, but nothing visible here indicates a security impact.
